name: ai-buddy
title: AI Buddy
description: AI helpers for daily work: translate, reply and rewrite text with any OpenAI-compatible LLM
author: hoang_tran

commands.name: reply
commands.title: Buddy Draft Reply
commands.description: Draft a reply for the selected chat messages; tweak it with your own idea

commands.name: rewrite
commands.title: Buddy Polish English
commands.description: Polish the selected English draft: correct grammar, natural wording, plus lessons to learn

commands.name: result
commands.title: Buddy Home
commands.description: Home: guide, settings and quick run for Translate / Draft Reply / Polish English

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Interface language. AI content (translations, Vietnamese meanings, lessons) is not affected.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1), LiteLLM…
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty to use the shared setup

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your API key for the endpoint

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Model name at the endpoint. A small, fast model is enough.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty to use the shared setup (e.g. gpt-5-mini)

preferences.name: fastMode
preferences.title: Speed
preferences.label: Skip model thinking (faster)
preferences.description: Sends reasoning_effort: none (retried without it if the provider rejects it).

preferences.name: mwKey
preferences.title: Merriam-Webster Key
preferences.description: Free Learner's Dictionary key from dictionaryapi.com for dictionary IPA. Optional: without it Wiktionary / AI is used.

scripts.share: npm test && bash scripts/pack.sh && open -R share/AI-Buddy.zip
